name: fve_metadata
description: Parse a BitLocker -FVE-FS- volume (raw image or VHD partition) and return metadata: GUID, encryption method, recovery key needed. Pass raw_offset to specify where the FVE partition starts.

path.description: Path to raw image or VHD file

raw_offset.description: Byte offset where the FVE partition starts (e.g., 65536 for VHD at LBA 128)
